name: simplepixelart-mcp
description: Turn images into pixel art, extract and remap palettes, and upscale sprites without blur.
long_description: Local pixel art tools for AI assistants: convert photos to pixel art with median-cut colours or palettes like PICO-8, Game Boy and ENDESGA 32, extract .gpl palettes, recolour sprites to a palette and upscale with nearest neighbour. Works on PNG and JPEG files or image URLs. No API keys.

tools.name: pixelate_image
tools.description: Turn a photo or illustration into pixel art and save a PNG

tools.name: extract_palette
tools.description: Extract the main colours of an image as hex codes and a .gpl palette

tools.name: remap_palette
tools.description: Recolour pixel art to a named palette or hex list

tools.name: upscale_pixel_art
tools.description: Upscale pixel art with nearest neighbour, no blur
